meta.title: Send a bulk counter offer to all vendors from Settings
warnings: resolved: “Verify the counter offer on every vendor's side when more than one vendor requires separate supplier-portal sessions.” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

plan.title: Send Bulk Counter Offer to Auction Vendors

steps.note: Open the existing live auction with bidding activity from the setup.
Open the auction Settings menu and choose the bulk counter-offer action.

args.goal: on the buyer's bulk counter-offer screen, decide the counter offer for all vendors, click Send, and stop when the screen shows the send succeeded

steps.note: Perform the bulk counter-offer configuration and send action, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Switch to the available invited vendor's supplier-portal session to inspect the vendor-side result.
Open the auction event in the vendor portal without entering a bid form.
Assert that the vendor's event view shows the received counter offer.
